analysis_scope: Representative J2 signal chain plus shared-reference AC/noise, separate REF and LDO tests; no MCU transistor or PCB field model

noise.scope_limit: Model nominal analog output noise only; ideal supplies; excludes ADC/VREF+ noise, PCB coupling, pump ripple, alias/noise folding validation

review_findings.assessment: Rail-range pass in nominal macro-models does not establish guaranteed precision/linearity at the -5% 3.3V corner. Check actual minimum supply and component/loading tolerance; consider reducing gain if that corner is required. No CAD change made.

sine_60hz.scope: TI opamp models with fixed ideal 0.968992248 V offset; separate from full REF AC/noise

step.scope: fixed ideal bias; entire analog filter step, NOT acquisition-switch settling

sampling_surrogate.assumptions: Cs/Ron from filename; 2.8V previous-channel step, repeated21.3675us; excludes switch charge injection and MCU transfer accuracy

reference.scope: Standalone REF+divider; excludes U32/R204/C159; constant 14.3mA supply load has nonphysical off-state behavior

negative_ldo.scope: 2013 TPS72301 transient model, ideal prescribed raw supply; excludes TPS60403, D20 powerdown and full worst-case load

debug_header.uart: CN4 USB-C -> CH340C(U8) -> PA10 RX / PA9 TX

limits: No Cadence PSpice engine; ngspice syntax/compatibility and model nominal results only
TPS60403 encrypted model not run or decrypted; charge-pump ripple, real rail sequence and worst-case current budget unverified
OPA320 official PSpice ZIP contains Q1 model; generic official TINA model was cross-checked, not falsely relabeled PSpice
No transistor-accurate STM32 ADC, MCU conversion/VREF noise, switch charge injection, PCB parasitics or hardware measurements
Startup full-chain cases with convergence failures are not accepted; standalone REF/LDO only
Passive tolerance and device limits are not covered by nominal macro-model sweeps; 16-bit resolution is not 16-bit absolute accuracy
